Proximity Sensor 1.0 (MZ)
reflector88
​
What is it?
This MZ plugin adds a "Proximity Sensor" plugin command that turns on a
switch/self-switch
when an event is near the player. Can also calculate
line of sight
.
I made this as an MZ equivalent to Vlue's Proximity Detection script for VXAce.
What is this for?
Puzzles, stealth sequences, or games with roaming enemies. Can also be used for aggro and hit detection in an ABS.
Features
Plug-and-play, easy to use
Change the distance and switches in the plugin command menu
"In direction facing" and "in orthogonal directions" options
Set line of sight obstacles using Region IDs and Terrain Tags
Video
How to Use
1. Put the .js file in your project's js/plugins/ folder.
2. In RMMZ, open the Plugin Manager through the Toolbar.
3. Double click an empty line, then use the "Name:" box to select "r88_ProximitySensor".
Download
Download on Itch.io
Terms and Credits
Free for commercial and non-commercial projects. Credit me if you found it helpful.

Click to expand...
My plugin references the default x and y properties of Game_CharacterBase, which are tile coordinates. My guess is that Chaucer's plugin overrides Game_CharacterBase in order to implement pixel movement.
The problem is definitely fixable, but it would be impossible on my end because I don't have access to their code. Your best bet is probably to ask Chaucer for help, since they have access to both.

Hello,
I'm not sure from the pictures what's wrong, but here are a couple of suggestions:
1. Make sure the event is a "Parallel Process".
2. Put the "Bell3" sound on a separate event page, and set the page's Conditions to "Self-Switch A". The way that the sensor works is that it activates a self-switch/switch when it detects you are close enough.
